messages:
Sam K: Heads-up — AuroraFin wants a short presales POC: streaming + function/tool calls producing strict JSON (they'll run schema validation), EU residency, CMK KMS. Also need a pricing anchor for ~20 concurrent streams at ~3k tokens/request, occasional spikes to 40.

Evelyn (SE): Got it. We support websocket/gRPC streaming. By default SDK buffers until function_call.complete, but set options.partial_tool_payload=true to receive incremental tool args. Example snippet: `ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'start', model:'redwood-stream-1', options:{partial_tool_payload:true}}))`.

Evelyn (SE): If they want to act on partial args, recommend progressive JSON-schema validation per delta. We have a small helper in the SDK to reassemble and validate partial fragments.

Ravi P: Commercial question: does streaming change token billing? And any quick sizing guidance for Dedicated for steady 20x3k tokens with bursts to 40? Need copyable anchor for procurement.

Evelyn (SE): Tokens billed the same. Dedicated reduces effective compute cost via batching and KV prefix caching. For a conservative pilot anchor: reserve capacity equivalent to ~3 GPU-units for steady 20 concurrent contexts for a medium model, enable autoscale and a 1-2 GPU burst pool for spikes. Recommend a 2-hour 20x3k load run to validate.

Nora (Security): I'll draft the questionnaire language. Draft boilerplate: "Dedicated: inference runs in a reserved Redwood cluster in the customer's selected region (EU available). Private: deployed into customer's VPC/on-prem so payloads do not leave customer network. We support customer-managed keys (CMK) via major cloud KMS and on-prem HSMs. SOC2/ISO artifacts available under NDA." Will refine with infra.

Sam K: AuroraFin also asked whether function-call payloads can stream as independent events (they want to start downstream work on partial args).

Evelyn (SE): Yes — we can emit deltas as standalone events. For webhook forwarding, add a small debounce at the forwarder to avoid overload. Latency to first partial typically 40-200ms depending on model and prompt; steady deltas ~150-400ms for long sequences. Partial mode adds minor client CPU overhead.

Ravi P: Suggest pilot commercial anchor: "1-month Dedicated pilot: 30% pilot credit on first month (up to 200 GPU-hours). Reserved capacity sized to support 20 concurrent 3k-token streams; autoscale for bursts. Overage billed at standard Dedicated rates; subject to legal." Copyable?

Nora (Security): Good start. I'll add the KMS contact and SOC2 link once infra confirms region placement and retention controls.

Evelyn (SE): I'll drop Node + Go snippets and a tiny load-test harness by EOD. Also will open a runbook for the POC and recommend eng-ml run 20x3k steady + a short spike to 40.

DeployBot: Runbook created: runbook://aurorafin-poc-3442109876 (access: sales,se,security,infra).

Sam K: Action items: (1) Nora finalize questionnaire text + SOC2 link, (2) Evelyn post snippets + perf note, (3) Ravi finalize procurement anchor with Finance, (4) schedule 30-min kickoff Tue 10am CET and include runbook.

Evelyn (SE): Quick dev tip: use `--simulate-partials` in the SDK sample to test progressive validation locally.

Sam K: Thanks team — I'll send the invite and include this thread in the kickoff packet. :thumbsup:
